delta: Success memory minus Direct routing. Higher deliveries, lower damage and lower movement energy are favourable, separately.
sample: Consecutive seeds fixed before execution; the same 20 seeds are reused at all three timings. This is not 60 independent seeds or a population-random sample.
selection: Closest total delivery difference, then damage, then energy
tieBreak: Ascending seed, then gate-change step. Example rules are independent and may select the same comparison.
inference: Descriptive means, medians, ranges and lower/equal/higher counts only. No p-values, confidence intervals, combined winner score or real-world claim.
